summary.one_line: The dated hash correction matches the committed LF bytes and preserves the original CRLF record.

purpose.evidence: Read all three changed Markdown files. The diary pair corrects which SHA-256 verifies the downloadable observations JSON while preserving the original local-working-copy hash as a dated historical record. CONTRIBUTING adds a general published-byte verification rule for future artifact updates.

structure.evidence: Both diary languages append a bold September 24 post-publication correction immediately after the original experiment-entry hash; they do not rewrite or erase it. The correction precedes the separate older pack_12 mode-review note, so readers can distinguish byte-distribution and algorithm-scope corrections. CONTRIBUTING adds the same compact rule in RU and EN within its existing diary/recording paragraph.

specificity.evidence: Independently read working JSON bytes and `git show HEAD:docs/assets/placement/observations.json`: working copy is 24511 bytes with 1592 CRLF sequences and SHA-256 3865ebc7623a024edafc5f208834070916b0bf651e27f5f3e63ba01b64f0718c; replacing CRLF with LF yields 22919 bytes and SHA-256 cdb06375ba4a46194f32eab8337a0087ca4df2cfab67b5633f33954b8f26ab28, byte-equal to Git blob. Both diary versions state these exact values and direct readers to the LF hash for downloads.

reproducibility.evidence: A reader can download the linked JSON and verify its SHA-256 against the new LF digest. Parent reports external HTTP bytes matched the Git blob; I independently verified the Git blob and CRLF-to-LF normalization, not a second HTTP fetch. No H5M, screenshot, Python code or observation data was changed in this correction. The prior build/test gates apply to unchanged assets; this review concerns the three text files.

evidence.evidence: The Git blob and local worktree comparison proved the difference is line endings alone: 1592 CRLF sequences become 1592 LF bytes, and the normalized worktree equals the committed blob exactly. The public diary retains the original hash and labels its scope. I did not re-execute the game or remeasure the elementals; the experiment data are byte-identical after newline normalization.

applicability.evidence: The correction is scoped to this text JSON and this Windows checkout versus Git/Pages LF publication. CONTRIBUTING says local Windows text copies can differ through CRLF/LF conversion, not that every download or asset transforms. The new hash is expressly the downloadable/Git-byte hash; the original is retained as the local Windows-byte hash.

translations.evidence: Russian and English diary corrections agree on date, original CRLF scope, 22919-byte LF size, cdb06375ba4a46194f32eab8337a0087ca4df2cfab67b5633f33954b8f26ab28 digest and instruction to use it for downloads. CONTRIBUTING adds equivalent published-byte guidance in both languages. Both translation pages retain reciprocal metadata and unchanged linked data.

maintenance.evidence: The correction follows the adopted diary rule: append a dated clarification rather than silently rewriting a published technical observation.
